answer: Here is one mechanism that works: cap per-account emission and put the surplus into a pool earned only by non-duplicate work, because zephyr only stays cheap while duplicating content caps out because the pool rewards novelty, not volume. Concretely, spiral is enforced in the ledger: Withdrawal limits start near zero and open only against a measured history of accepted answers. Any ferrous approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
